text.excerpt: Bran Castle, the Transfăgărășan, and three days at a cabin with no signal.
text.intro: The Transfăgărășan is the kind of road you plan a whole trip around, and it earned it. We only had one day on it, but that was enough to fall in love with it completely — every switchback and viewpoint felt worth the hype.
